prompt.name: SEO: Keyword Research
prompt.description: Discover ranking opportunities and produce an SEO content brief for a target keyword.
prompt.template:
Run keyword research and produce an SEO brief for: {{seed_keyword}}

Site: {{site_url}}

stages.name: Expand keyword
stages.prompt: Generate 25 long-tail variants of the seed keyword grouped by intent.

stages.name: Competitor scan
stages.prompt: Identify the top 5 ranking pages for the seed keyword. Summarize what they cover and where they fall short.

stages.name: Brief
stages.prompt: Produce an SEO brief: title options, H2 structure, FAQ block, internal-link suggestions, and target word count.
